contentText:
GTA VI earned $3.79 billion in its first day of sales, which set "a new record for entertainment across any medium," according to an announcement from Rockstar Games . The game also sold 32.5 million preorder copies.

"It is with immense gratitude that we enter a new chapter of Rockstar Games with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI ," Sam Houser, Rockstar's president and founder, said in a statement. "We are incredibly humbled by the response from players around the world and we couldn't be more excited to share this moment with you."
